baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is an allotted benefit whose usable amplitude is alternately spread and narrowed; expansion and constriction are two operations within one measured distribution, not presence versus absence of divine action.

activation_trace.role: The image of spreading against contraction supplies the expansive pole of one controlled range.
An assigned gift or share makes provision the distributed object rather than an ownerless quantity.
Will directed toward bringing about a thing supplies the selective agency governing the range.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the contracting pole paired with spreading.

changed_reading.before: God gives some people more wealth and others less.
changed_reading.after: God varies the spread and aperture of an assigned provision-field; both abundance and restriction are active modes of measurement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Near life and later life establish nested horizons. What looks encompassing inside the near horizon is recategorized within the later one as a usable article for enjoyment and need: real benefit, but instrumental and proportionally small.

activation_trace.role: The nearer or first horizon supplies the observer's close field rather than an exhaustive world.
Posteriority supplies the larger horizon within which near life is rescaled.
Portable utility used to meet a need turns near life from destination into equipment.
Actual enjoyment and benefit keep the comparison from denying that near life has genuine use.

changed_reading.after: Near life is genuine but subordinate equipment: useful and enjoyable within its field, radically rescaled when located inside later life.

baseline_models.mechanism: The joy root can name simple opening of the chest or boastful excess. Here the attached object and immediate horizon-comparison make the diagnosis relational: delight becomes distorting when near life is allowed to set the whole scale.

activation_trace.role: Open-chested delight supplies the affect itself without making that affect intrinsically blameworthy.
Exultant self-satisfaction supplies the possible distortion produced by treating the near horizon as final.
Proximity makes the enjoyed object affectively dominant and explains how scale can be misread.

changed_reading.after: The verse tests what happiness is fastened to: ordinary delight can become boastful capture when the nearest life monopolizes perspective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent plots receive one water yet produce differentiated edible yield. This makes the focus distribution more than unequal access: a common input can be routed through distinct receivers into unequal surplus.

activation_trace.role: Amplitude and increase anchor the agricultural conversion model back in the focus act of expansion.
An irrigation share and its channel supply a routed common input to the mechanism.
Union in one direction makes the water a controlled common source rather than several inputs.
Increase or remainder supplies the differentiated surplus emerging from the same source.
Plant yield supplies the concrete output by which differentiated provision becomes visible.

structural_cues: 13:4 orders adjacent plots, one water, and then preference of some yield over other yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common irrigation and unequal output; I map the receivers to the focus's selective recipients and treat conversion as the arrow. A live alternative is simple preference without any claim about receiver capacity.

changed_reading.before: Different provision means different quantities supplied at the source.
changed_reading.after: Provision can diverge after a common supply: routing and receiver-specific yield are part of how divine expansion and restriction appear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden diminution and growth occur under exact measure, while communal condition changes through alteration within selves. Together they activate provision as a dynamic state with concealed increments and responsive transitions, not a frozen allotment.

activation_trace.role: Diminution supplies an unseen contracting process rather than a single completed shortage.
Growth supplies the paired hidden expansion within the same embodied process.
A quantity reaching its bounded amount places both hidden movements under measure.
Replacement of one condition by another supplies a reversible state transition.
The inward faculty supplies the site at which the context locates human-side alteration.

structural_cues: 13:8 pairs what wombs diminish and increase before universal measure; 13:11 repeats change on divine and human sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies biological decrease/increase and a separate social change construction; I join them as an analogy for dynamic provision. It remains possible that 13:11 concerns condition generally and does not specify material provision.

changed_reading.before: Each person's provision is a fixed amount assigned once.
changed_reading.after: Measured provision may be a changing trajectory whose growth, loss, and human-side transitions remain partly hidden while divine agency still frames the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same spreading root moves from God's effective expansion of provision to a person's outstretched palms before water that never reaches the mouth. The contrast inserts a delivery gap between desire, apparent access, and actual receipt.

activation_trace.role: An extended hand for requesting or taking supplies a human-scale but ineffective counterpart to divine spreading.
The palm held out in request fixes the bodily posture of desired reception.
Water supplies visible sustenance that is near enough to address yet not actually received.
Arrival at a goal supplies the explicitly failed transfer from resource to mouth.
Effective extension anchors the failed hand-image back to the focus's divine provision act.

structural_cues: 13:14 compares unanswered invocation to palms extended toward water while negating the water's arrival at the mouth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated root, outstretched palms, water, and non-arrival; I infer a contrast of effective and ineffective transfer. The simile can alternatively remain limited to invocation rather than material receipt.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is simply a quantity lying within reach.
changed_reading.after: Provision is an effective arrival relation; wanting, gesturing toward, or standing near a resource does not itself make that resource received.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water runs through valleys according to their measure and carries swelling foam; the same foam appears while producing ornaments or utility. What rises most visibly leaves, while benefit remains. Expansion is therefore channel-shaped, and conspicuous surplus can be residue rather than provision's durable value.

activation_trace.role: Flood-flow supplies the moving resource whose spread must take a channel.
A valley as the flood's path supplies receiver shape and carrying capacity.
A bounded amount makes each channel's measure govern the flow it bears.
Floating froth supplies conspicuous excess that rides above rather than constituting the useful flow.
Increase and elevation explain why the least durable layer can look like the greatest expansion.
A useful article links the smelting image directly to the focus's classification of near life as utility.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion that separates provision from mere visible volume.
Staying through time supplies persistence as the test of useful residue.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats foam in both flood and smelting sequences, then opposes its departure to the staying of what benefits people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured channels, rising foam, manufactured utility, departure, and remaining benefit; I infer that these diagnose the focus's visible abundance. The live alternative is that the analogy concerns truth and falsehood only, without an economic extension.

changed_reading.before: The largest visible expansion is the clearest sign of abundant provision.
changed_reading.after: Provision is capacity-shaped flow, and its swollen visible layer may be foam; durable benefit, not apparent volume, reveals what the expansion carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is immediately shown leaving possession through expenditure and sitting inside a sequence of maintained bonds; the inverse sequence severs, cuts, and corrupts. Its realized value is thus circulatory and connective, not exhausted by stock held.

activation_trace.role: Maintaining connection and refusing estrangement supplies the social channel through which provision can function.
Money going out as expenditure supplies intentional outflow rather than retained stock.
The allotted gift is explicitly the source from which the outflow is made, tying circulation to focus provision.
Severing a bond supplies the inverse operation that breaks the connective route.
Departure from sound balance supplies the resulting network failure rather than mere low quantity.

structural_cues: 13:22 places expenditure from provision beside warding harm with good; د ر ء lacks a branch inventory and is used only as this sequence cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision-funded expenditure, maintained bonds, severance, and corruption; I supply the flow-network relation among them. These ethical acts may expose provision's use without mechanically causing its material amount.

changed_reading.before: Provision is chiefly what a recipient possesses.
changed_reading.after: Provision becomes legible in passage: what leaves as expenditure, sustains bonds, and repairs harm can be more fully provision than a larger disconnected stock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact will formula reappears with leading astray and guiding rather than with provision. Reuse across distinct predicates blocks a simple equation between expanded livelihood and moral favor: material amplitude and orientation are axes that can diverge.

activation_trace.role: The repeated willing of an outcome transfers the focus formula intact onto a non-economic axis.
Departure from guidance supplies one outcome that cannot be read directly from material expansion.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies the opposed orientation axis.
The focus occurrence anchors the repeated formula to selective material distribution.

structural_cues: 13:27 repeats مَن يَشَاءُ after a guidance predicate and follows guidance with the relative clause مَنْ أَنَابَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula with different predicates; I infer that the two result axes must not be collapsed. A live alternative is rhetorical continuity without a formal warning against prosperity-based moral ranking.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision indicates that its recipient is better guided or favored.
changed_reading.after: Material spread is not a moral rank: the repeated will formula governs a distinct guidance axis, so abundance and orientation may cross rather than coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later-life horizon contains flowing water, edible yield, and shade marked by continuity. The contrast with near-life utility is therefore not material pleasure versus immaterial value, but timed usefulness versus provision whose yield and shelter do not lapse.

activation_trace.role: Continuing gift and provision supplies an ongoing flow within the later horizon.
An edible share or sustenance supplies concrete provision rather than an abstract reward.
Continuance supplies the duration property that near-life utility lacks.
Protective shelter supplies a persistent environmental benefit alongside edible yield.
Enjoyment extended only for a term anchors the finite side of the duration contrast.

structural_cues: 13:35 places flowing rivers, enduring yield, and shade inside the explicitly named outcome horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensuous provision plus continuity in the later horizon; I infer that duration, not materiality itself, sharpens the focus contrast. The scene may also function independently as reward imagery.

changed_reading.before: Calling near life utility rejects bodily enjoyment in favor of a non-material afterlife.
changed_reading.after: The later horizon also has embodied provision; what distinguishes near-life utility is its expiring term, not its material or pleasurable character.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same joy root later describes recipients delighting in what was sent down. With affect held constant and its object changed, the focus criticism settles on orientation and object, not on joy as such.

activation_trace.role: Boastful delight supplies the focus's potentially distorted affective mode.
Simple gladness supplies a positive realization of the same root under a different object.

structural_cues: The joy predicate takes near life as its object in 13:26 but what was sent down in 13:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated affect with changed objects; I infer that object-orientation governs the evaluation. Different subjects and local rhetoric remain additional possible reasons for the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Joy is the moral failure named in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: Joy is morally mobile: it can become possessive exultation over the near horizon or receptive delight in disclosure, depending on what organizes it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contraction receives a spatial process-image: land is diminished from its edges. The focus restriction can therefore be imagined as attrition at boundaries and access points while the center still appears intact, not only as one central reduction in quantity.

activation_trace.role: Reduction to a narrow measure anchors the spatial analogy in the focus's contraction verb.
Loss of part of a whole supplies incremental attrition rather than total disappearance.
The boundary or endpoint locates where contraction first becomes visible.

structural_cues: 13:41 orders approach to the land, its diminution, and the prepositional specification from its edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge-loss of land; I import that material process as an analogy for yaqdiru. Its immediate referent may be geographic or political, so the provision reading remains cross-domain rather than lexical identity.

changed_reading.before: Constriction is a uniform reduction of a person's total stock.
changed_reading.after: Constriction may arrive peripherally: shrinking reach, territory, channels, or options can reduce provision before the apparent center is depleted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The debt-and-deposit branch is surprising and form-distant from the focus verb, but it remains anchored in the joy root and coheres with allotted provision plus eventual relinquishment. Render only as a lexical resonance: expanded goods may feel like delight while functioning as an entrusted burden, not as the direct sense of فَرِحُوا.

activation_trace.role: The root's debt-or-deposit burden supplies an inverted weight beneath apparent delight.
An apportioned gift supplies the entrusted object whose possession need not equal ownership.
Taking a thing away or becoming independent of it supplies eventual release from the held utility.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is uncomplicated gain enjoyed by its holder.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, the gain may also be a deposit-like load: pleasurable in hand, weighty in custody, and not finally retained.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-branch coupling is surprising because the focus uses basṭ materially, yet the same root inventory explicitly carries psychological ease and the ayah immediately names joy. Keep it as an affective echo, not a replacement translation: outward amplitude may dilate mood and help explain fixation.

activation_trace.role: Psychological ease and pleasure let material expansion echo as an inward dilation.
Open-chested gladness supplies the affective response that completes the feedback loop.
Nearness supplies the attentional bias by which the immediately expanded field dominates feeling.

changed_reading.before: The provision clause and joy clause report separate facts.
changed_reading.after: They may also form a feedback sequence: outward spread produces inward dilation, and the nearness of its object converts that dilation into horizon-capture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The erasure-and-confirmation sequence is a remote contextual activation, not a license to settle doctrines of decree. It remains anchored through repeated will-language and the focus's measuring verb; qualify it as a possible distinction between mutable manifested allocations and a larger stable frame.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to bringing about an outcome anchors later erasure and confirmation to the focus's selective agency.
Deliberative measuring supplies an ordered frame within which manifested states could change.
Removal of a trace supplies the possibility that a presently visible allocation is not permanent.
The repeated will construction supplies the verbal bridge back to the focus formula.
Continuance and stability supply the opposed operation to erasure within one governed sequence.

changed_reading.before: Expansion or constriction is a visibly fixed assignment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the visible assignment may be mutable through erasure and confirmation while still belonging to a more comprehensive measured order.

strongest_changes: Measured provision became channel-shaped flow whose conspicuous expansion may be departing foam rather than durable benefit.
Provision became a connective outflow realized through expenditure and maintained bonds, not merely stock possessed.
Repeated joy and will formulas separated affect from its object and material amplitude from moral guidance.
Constriction acquired a peripheral process-image: loss can begin at edges, routes, and options before the center appears empty.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact oppositions repeatedly reopened under material context: one water yielded differently, stretched hands failed to receive, measured valleys sorted foam from benefit, finite utility contrasted with enduring embodied provision, and the same joy root changed valence with its object.
remaining_uncertainties: Receiver capacity is inferred from the plot and valley analogies; the packet does not state that it exhaustively explains selective provision.
The relation between human-side change and material provision remains analogical rather than explicit.
Debt-burden, affective basṭ, edge-loss, and mutable-record readings require downstream containment as lexical or cross-domain activations.
